physicalNotes: Radius 0.73 Jupiter radii from Bieryla et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.52710955B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.52710955B/abstract): 52,189.2 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Bieryla et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.52710955B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.52710955B/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 3.87 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
